title: Millington FY2025 operating spending per pupil: saved calculation inputs
kind: Reviewed extract, not the original state workbook
scope: Operating spending from all funding sources, including state, county, municipal and federal resources. Excludes capital and other non-operating categories in the state definition. The denominator is October 1 enrollment, not average daily membership or attendance. City historical support is a separate measure and is not this numerator.
